description: Crawl a web app / site / SaaS surface with Comber and report broken clicks, dead ends, console errors, and broken links. Read-only by default (does not submit forms or trigger mutations). Great to run against a preview/staging URL before merging. Optional LLM finding-judge only runs if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set in the environment.

allowWrites.description: DANGER: exercise mutating controls/methods (submits, deletes). Off by default. Only enable against a disposable target you own.

crossOrigin.description: Follow links off the start origin. Default: same-origin only.

maxActions.description: Cap on total actions taken (runaway-cost backstop).

maxStates.description: Cap on distinct app states to explore (runaway-cost backstop).

strict.description: Return a failing summary if any 'fail' finding is present (gate a merge).

url.description: The URL to crawl (e.g. a preview deployment).

name: comber_check
title: comber check (web)
